sql: SELECT * FROM [employees] ORDER BY CASE WHEN [code] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, [code] COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AS ASC, CASE WHEN [age] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, [age] ASC, CASE WHEN [code] COLLATE Latin1_General_CS_AS IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, [code] COLLATE Latin1_General_CS_AS ASC OFFSET @p1 ROWS FETCH NEXT @p2 ROWS ONLY
